body:
## Pull request overview

Console UI design sweep focused on WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility improvements, spacing/layout consistency, and closer alignment with Shadcn design tokens/components across major console pages.

**Changes:**
- Improved keyboard/screen-reader support (ARIA attributes, live regions for spinners, labels for search inputs, improved focus discoverability).
- Standardized spacing/layout across Home, metadata pages, and DashboardView; unified grids and padding scales.
- Increased Shadcn alignment by replacing hardcoded badge styles and native checkboxes; extracted shared `capitalizeFirst()` helper.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 17 out of 17 changed files in this pull request and generated 5 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the UI/accessibility sweep and design-token alignment work. |
| apps/console/src/utils.ts | Adds `capitalizeFirst()` utility for consistent label casing. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/SystemHubPage.tsx | Adds live-region semantics for loading and keyboard interaction for clickable cards. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/ProfilePage.tsx | Adds `aria-required` to required input for improved SR signaling. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/MetadataManagerPage.tsx | Adds sr-only label + input id; adds live regions for loading/saving; adjusts grid gap. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/MetadataDetailPage.tsx | Adds live-region semantics to loading indicator. |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/AppManagementPage.tsx | Replaces native checkboxes with Shadcn `Checkbox`; adds sr-only search label and ARIA labels for row actions. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/StarredApps.tsx | Unifies grid breakpoints, adds keyboard activation for cards, uses `capitalizeFirst()`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/RecentApps.tsx | Unifies grid breakpoints, adds keyboard activation for cards, uses `capitalizeFirst()`. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/QuickActions.tsx | Adds keyboard activation + aria-label for action cards. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/HomePage.tsx | Adjusts responsive padding and typography sizing for consistency. |
| apps/console/src/pages/home/AppCard.tsx | Improves favorite toggle accessibility; replaces hardcoded “Default” badge styling with Shadcn `Badge`. |
| apps/console/src/components/SearchResultsPage.tsx | Adds sr-only label and improves focus ring visibility on result links. |
| apps/console/src/components/MetadataGrid.tsx | Adds table aria-label and tooltips for truncated cell values. |
| apps/console/src/components/MetadataFormDialog.tsx | Improves required indicator SR behavior; adds `aria-required` + focus ring styling to native select. |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Adds toolbar semantics + focus-visible rings to widget toolbar; adjusts responsive padding scale. |
| apps/console/src/components/AuthPageLayout.tsx | Adds accessible SVG logo metadata (role/label/title). |
</details>

These Cards are given `role="link"` but the keyboard handler also activates navigation on the Space key. Per ARIA/link interaction patterns, links should activate on Enter (Space is typically reserved for buttons and scrolling). Consider either (a) rendering a real `<Link>`/`<a>` for proper link semantics, or (b) switching to `role="button"` if Space activation is desired.

This Card uses `role="link"` but the `onKeyDown` handler treats Space like activation. For link semantics, activation should be Enter-only; if you want Space activation, use `role="button"` (or render a real `<Link>`/`<a>`). This avoids unexpected behavior for keyboard/AT users.

This Card is declared as `role="link"` but it navigates on Space as well as Enter. Space activation is not standard for links and can interfere with expected scrolling behavior. Prefer a real `<Link>`/`<a>` or adjust the role/key handling to match link vs button interaction patterns.

This Card is labeled `role="link"` but the keyboard handler also navigates on Space. For accessibility consistency, links should activate on Enter; Space activation implies `role="button"`. Consider using an actual `<Link>`/`<a>` element for navigation to get correct semantics and browser behaviors (open in new tab, context menu).

`capitalizeFirst` uses `toUpperCase()`, which is not locale-aware; the docstring claim about "i18n compatibility" is therefore misleading. Either adjust the wording to reflect that this is a simple ASCII/Unicode case mapping, or consider a locale-aware approach (e.g., `toLocaleUpperCase()` / passing a locale) if this is intended for end-user text.
